div.head: Northu 30
div.ab: Gif preost wið oðerne gefeohte, bete him ⁊ biscope.
Gif preost wið oðerne gefeohte, bete him and biscope.
Wenn éin Priester gegen den andern [Priester] ficht, büsse er diesem und dem Bischofe.
If one priest fights against another [priest], let him atone to him and to the bishop.
If a priest fights another, he is to pay compensation to him and to the bishop.
If a priest fights with another, he is to make amends to him and to the bishop.
div.note: ‘⁊ b[iscope]’ was added in the 11th century.; U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘If a priest fights another, he is to pay compensation to him and the bishop.’).
